messages.subject: Representation of violin chart
parts:
Hi
I use the following command to create a violin chart.

ggplot(mydata, aes(x = BEN))
+ geom_violin(aes(y = OCC, weight = WG), trim = FALSE)
+ geom_dotplot(binaxis='y', stackdir='center', dotsize=0.6)

But the chart looks weird. You can see that on https://pasteboard.co/K2MgONDU.png
I also get the following warnings

`stat_bindot()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value with `binwidth`.
Warning messages:
1: In max(f) : no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
2: Computation failed in `stat_bindot()`:
argument must be coercible to non-negative integer


The data values look normal ranging from 0 to 100.
What does that mean? Any idea about that?

Regards,
Mahmood
